text:
tess_marketing: Quick request: for the launch post we need a small reproducible perf bundle: public headline numbers + an internal artifact pack. Sam, can runtime produce a short summary (p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens for fp16 vs 4bit) and a pasteable repro command?

sam_runtime: yes. Suggest N=400 runs per slice, warmup=80, seed=7, batch=4. We'll produce marketing-summary.json (public) and artifacts-private.tar.gz (internal).

kai_bench: add a tiny long-tail slice (2% at 6k tokens) and a 5% randomized holdout run. Also run one repeat to show variance.

jess_pipeline: I'll upload public files to gs://redwood-marketing/launch-2026-03/ and private to gs://redwood-internal/bench-launch-1765503210/ with signed urls. CI will post links.

sam_runtime: Repro snippet to paste: 
```bash
./tools/bench_run --model redwood-open-7b --iters 400 --batch 4 --warmup 80 --seed 7 --quant fp16,4bit --payloads gs://redwood-marketing/launch-2026-03/payloads.json --out gs://redwood-marketing/launch-2026-03/runs/1765503210/
```

legalbot: quick note: avoid "guarantee" language. suggested blurb: "Median latency measured over 400 runs after an 80-request warmup; quantized figures use static 4-bit quantization on identical infra."

tess_marketing: perfect. timeline: public summary + one sample link by tomorrow noon, full deep artifacts next day. Thanks everyone!
